unRules.Taiwan: Since General Assembly Resolution 2758 (1971) the UN depicts Taiwan as part of China. In practice it is governed separately by the Republic of China government.
unRules.Kosovo: Not a UN member. UN maps cite Security Council Resolution 1244 (1999) and draw only a separating line with Serbia.
unRules.W. Sahara: Classified by the UN as a non-self-governing territory (final status undetermined).
unRules.Gaza: Depicted by the UN as occupied Palestinian territory. Palestine has been a non-member observer state since 2012.
unRules.West Bank: Depicted by the UN as occupied Palestinian territory. Palestine has been a non-member observer state since 2012.
unRules.East Jerusalem: Regarded by the UN as part of the occupied Palestinian territory.
unRules.Golan Heights: Regarded by the UN as Syrian territory occupied by Israel (Security Council Resolution 497, 1981).
unRules.Crimea: General Assembly Resolution 68/262 (2014) affirmed Ukraine's territorial integrity. The UN depicts it as part of Ukraine.
unRules.Donetsk People's Republic: General Assembly Resolution ES-11/4 (2022) declared Russia's proclaimed annexation invalid. The UN depicts it as part of Ukraine.
unRules.Luhansk People's Republic: General Assembly Resolution ES-11/4 (2022) declared Russia's proclaimed annexation invalid. The UN depicts it as part of Ukraine.
unRules.N. Cyprus: Security Council Resolution 541 (1983) called the declaration of independence legally invalid. The UN depicts it as part of Cyprus.
unRules.Abkhazia: Depicted by the UN as part of Georgia.
unRules.South Ossetia: Depicted by the UN as part of Georgia.
unRules.Transnistria: Depicted by the UN as part of Moldova.
unRules.Somaliland: Depicted by the UN as part of Somalia.
unRules.Artsakh: Depicted by the UN as part of Azerbaijan. Azerbaijan has controlled it since September 2023, and the self-declared republic dissolved itself as of 1 January 2024.
unRules.Jammu and Kashmir: UN maps draw the Line of Control dotted and note that the final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not been agreed by the parties.
unRules.Azad Kashmir: UN maps draw the Line of Control dotted and note that the final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not been agreed by the parties.
unRules.Gilgit-Baltistan: UN maps draw the Line of Control dotted and note that the final status of Jammu and Kashmir has not been agreed by the parties.
unRules.Aksai Chin: UN maps mark the boundary in this area as undetermined.
unRules.Dokdo: Under South Korea's effective control. The Korean government's position is that no territorial dispute exists; the UN takes no position on sovereignty.
Administered by Russia; Japan claims the four southern islands. The UN takes no position on sovereignty.
On the UN list of non-self-governing territories.
unRules.Gibraltar: On the UN list of non-self-governing territories.
General Assembly Resolution 73/295 (2019) regarded the Chagos Archipelago as part of Mauritius and called on the United Kingdom to withdraw.
